arena.name: BUET campus
arena.subtitle: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology

location.name: ECE Building
location.clue: The building of electrical and computer engineering.
Circuits, code and a long list of labs.
Where electrons and algorithms share the same corridor.

location.name: Administrative Building
location.clue: Where the university's official papers are handled.
Every certificate and notice begins its journey here.
The desk where a student's fate is stamped and signed.

location.name: BUET Health Complex
location.clue: Where sick students get checked by a doctor.
The first stop for fevers, cuts and headaches.
Where a white coat and a prescription pad wait for you.

location.name: Gymnasium
location.clue: A place for exercise and indoor sports.
Weights, mats and sweaty evenings.
Where muscles are built after a long day of brain work.

location.name: Shaheed Minar
location.clue: A monument that remembers the language movement.
Flowers are laid here every February.
Bare feet and a sunrise procession on the twenty-first.

location.name: Central Mosque
location.clue: A place of prayer on campus.
A calm place where the day is measured in prayers.
Five times a day, a call from here is heard across campus.

location.name: BUET Cafeteria
location.clue: Where students go to eat and drink tea.
Tea, snacks and the loudest conversations on campus.
Empty stomachs, full tables and the best gossip in town.

location.name: Staff Canteen
location.clue: A canteen mostly used by university staff.
Lunch for teachers and employees, away from the student crowd.
A quieter table where the university's grown-ups eat.

location.name: EME Building
location.clue: The building of electrical and mechanical engineering.
Machines, motors and heavy equipment.
Where power and motion are both studied.

location.name: Civil Building
location.clue: The building of the civil engineering department.
Bridges, concrete and structures are studied here.
Future builders of roads and bridges practice their calculations here.

location.name: Architecture Building
location.clue: The building of the architecture department.
Sketches, models and sleepless design nights.
Where students draw tomorrow's buildings on paper today.
